tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 est., -2bp from Aug 4's 140bp as US-Iran deal hopes extended the relief tightening) but remains well above the Jun 22-23 compression zone. The relief is building on a genuine diplomatic track - Bessent says a Hormuz deal could come 'today or tomorrow' (CNBC, Aug 4) - but no final agreement is signed and the strait remains physically closed with attacks continuing. Maintain protection at 60-70%; do not reduce on the tactical tightening. Stress (45%): iTraxx returns to 150-180bp if talks stall. Tail (30%): spikes to 200-230bp if strikes resume at scale. Only reduce on a confirmed reopening with sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF €55.06/MWh (Aug 5, Trading Economics) while JKM $22.00/MMBtu carried (Jul 24) — the JKM-TTF spread has narrowed as a potential Hormuz reopening threatens the Gulf supply squeeze. Qatar's force majeure remains extended into mid-September and a de-escalation resolution is being circulated, but no final deal is signed. The long-JKM/short-TTF thesis that relied on Asia's supply-lag premium is dead; keep the position closed. A confirmed reopening would compress both markers; a collapsed deal would re-widen the spread.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

tradeIdeas.title: Close ASEAN Banks Long / Hold Energy Underweight - Compression Trade Invalidated
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 est., -2bp) — the deal-driven relief extends the tightening but the structural thesis remains unproven until a reopening is signed. ASEAN Banks ~207.5 idx est. (+0.4%) still green zscore. ASEAN Energy ~116 idx est. (-1.9%, tracking Brent's -5.8% Tuesday slide) remains deeply depressed vs baseline (zscore -2.35) — the war-zone discount persists even as deal hopes build. Hold the energy underweight; close the banks long only when a reopening is confirmed and credit spreads show sustained compression.
instruments: ASEAN Banks ETF (hold neutral, no long)

tradeIdeas.title: Maintain Long USD/PHP and USD/IDR - Pause Is Tactical, Not Structural
tradeIdeas.rationale: USD/PHP ~55.5 est. (Aug 5, -0.3%) and USD/IDR ~15,750 est. (-0.2%) continued to soften as US-Iran deal hopes lifted EM FX. The relief should not be used to reverse positions — no final deal is signed, Hormuz remains physically closed with a second vessel struck off Khasab within 24 hours, and Brent at $79.18 still sits well above pre-crisis levels. Maintain short PHP/IDR (long USD) positions; re-enter long PHP/IDR only on a confirmed Hormuz reopening with sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: ASEAN EM FX basket (maintain short vs USD)
